Microarray Assay.sample_type: whole-blood lysate; capillary blood collected by finger stick; isolated neutrophils, monocytes, CD4+ T cells, and CD8+ T cells
Microarray Assay.readouts: whole-genome transcriptional profiles; signal-intensity values; changes in transcript abundance; module-level gene expression signatures

Flow Cytometry.readouts: cell population measurements including plasmablasts/plasma cells and CD19+ B cells; absolute numbers and composition of the B cell compartment

In Vitro Stimulation with Innate Immune.original_name: In Vitro Stimulation with Innate Immune Ligands
In Vitro Stimulation with Innate Immune.readouts: gene-expression profiles/transcript abundance after 6 hr stimulation with innate immune ligands and cytokines

Hemagglutinin Inhibition.readouts: neutralizing antibody titers against seasonal influenza strains; reciprocal highest dilution with no hemagglutinating activity; HAI titers

Virus-neutralization assays.readouts: neutralizing antibody titers against seasonal influenza strains; VN titers

Multiplex Cytokine Analysis.readouts: cytokine and chemokine production/levels, including serum CXCL10 (IP-10)
